# Lighthill Studio

> Lighthill Studio is a 1,200 sq ft infinity wall (cyclorama) photography studio in Lawrenceville, Georgia (Gwinnett County), just outside Atlanta. Co-owners Luz Reyes and Hillary Urgelles run in-house photo sessions and rent the studio by the hour to photographers, videographers, and small productions.

## In-house photography
Directed sessions on a white infinity wall (cyclorama) with studio strobe lighting: maternity, newborn, family, branding, headshots, seasonal mini sessions, celebrations (birthdays, cake smash), and podcast/video interviews. Pricing is quoted per project; inquire through the contact page.

- [Book a shoot](https://www.lighthillstudio.com/contact?type=shoot)
- [Gallery](https://www.lighthillstudio.com/gallery)
- [Team](https://www.lighthillstudio.com/team)

## Studio rental
- Open 24 hours, 7 days a week; rentals can start at any half hour
- Rate: $55 per hour, two-hour minimum
- 20% off bookings of eight hours or more
- 50% deposit to confirm online; balance due at the studio
- Instant booking with live availability: https://www.lighthillstudio.com/rent
- Also bookable on Peerspace: https://www.peerspace.com/pages/listings/6a74b0ccd2019fc79dd2f88e
- Add-ons: paper backdrop rolls, flashes, softboxes, studio assistant
- Capacity 20 guests, street-level access, free on-site parking, changing room and restroom
- Address: 1766 Old Norcross Rd, Ste Y, Lawrenceville, GA 30044
